opening.argument: The video solicits viewers to join BitConnect lending through a description promising “Earn 1% Daily On Your Lend” and a link. The speaker directs them to begin through that link, states that the minimum lend is $100, and instructs them to transfer Bitcoin from a wallet or exchange into a BitConnect account. The solicitation is reinforced by personal lending plans and referral promotion, while the interface shows team, referral, deposit, receiving, and sending functions. Although the speaker acknowledges cryptocurrency risk and says payouts depend on volatility, those qualifications do not undo the concrete invitation to deposit Bitcoin for a stated daily return. The evidence establishes an investment-pool and lending solicitation without establishing that the promised returns or any resulting outcome were verified.
